sections.heading: coverThesis
sections.body: Your professional path is best approached as a sequence of deliberate experiments grounded in your public role, values, and practical agency.

sections.heading: careerArchetype
sections.body: Your career archetype is Disciplined Craftsperson: Saturn to Sun/MC -> disciplined, masterful.

sections.heading: publicRole
sections.body: The Midheaven evidence points to a public role shaped by taurus themes and the chart's 10th-house ruler.

sections.heading: moneyPsychology
sections.body: Money choices become clearer when you separate security needs from the value you want your work to create.

sections.heading: dailyWork
sections.body: Design daily work around repeatable strengths, clear boundaries, and tasks that keep your judgment engaged.

sections.heading: growthEngine
sections.body: Growth comes from building a visible body of work and choosing opportunities that compound skill, trust, and reach.

sections.heading: legacyPower
sections.body: Your longer-term influence grows when practical results and meaningful contribution reinforce each other.

sections.heading: careerCompass
sections.body: Use this map as a decision aid: notice the window, name the choice, test the next step, and review the result.
